propositions: Fixture setup consumes 47% of tests/interfaces wall-clock (306ms per test via function-scoped rebar_repo) due to repeated git init and config spawns across 589 test functions.

Session-scoped template with per-test copytree reduces fixture time 306ms -> 22.3ms (13.7x), but requires four fix-ups: worktree pointers, gate snapshot store keying, environment identity randomization, and module-global cache reset.

Bare git worktree repair silently fails to fix stale gitdir pointers and corrupts the source store; fix-up must unconditionally rewrite both .tickets-tracker/.git and .git/worktrees/*/gitdir against realpath.
A tier-wide autouse guard must verify all git worktree list paths resolve inside REBAR_ROOT, using worktree list rather than git-common-dir which structurally cannot witness stale gitdir.
.env-id and .signing-key must be unconditionally re-randomized after each copy, bypassing the idempotency guard in init._gen_local_files() to prevent silent no-op.

Template fixture must build in isolated MonkeyPatch context pinning REBAR_ROOT, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, and clearing REBAR_TRACKER_DIR/BRANCH/CONFIG, then assert virgin state (.tickets-tracker on tickets branch, no tickets, no .rebar/) before any test runs.
